input.summary: Grounds and lean-to is built and make.sh writes build.nbt. The REFUSED writes are gone: the shed's slab course was already laid by the Roofs part, so the grounds part no longer writes it, and its four posts stay. The Grounds line now reads 341 placed, 0 refused, 0 off-palette.
left: Drying lean-to room (room-4) still reports REFUSED 10 writes: barrels at (15,1,18) and (15,1,19), and fences/trapdoors at x=17, z=19..24. Those are the candle racks and tallow barrels grounds.mjs places in the same cells, and both parts want them. Not fixed here because those refusals sit in room-4's line, not the Grounds line, and deciding which part owns the lean-to furniture is a design call.
The lean-to slab course is now owned by parts/roofs.mjs alone. leanToBay still names those cells for the posts at z=18, 21, 24, but its helper skips non-air cells silently, so they are not counted.
